hypothesis.statement: Continuous long exposure to MNQ represents the passive market return over the fixed evaluation window.
hypothesis.economic_rationale: The benchmark measures broad Nasdaq futures price appreciation and drawdown independently of any active strategy signal.

direction.long: Continuous normalized long exposure of 1.0 from the first eligible session close.

signal.calculation: Take the last valid MNQ close at the 16:00 cash close, or at the official CME early close on a shortened session, and compute equity_t = initial_capital * close_t / first_close.
signal.signal_timestamp: Each applicable session close after that close is observed.

entry.condition: First valid session close in the fixed evaluation window.
entry.execution_price: First valid session close, used only as the normalization denominator.
entry.execution_delay: None; this is a price-index benchmark, not an executable strategy fill model.

exit.time_exit: Last valid session close of the fixed evaluation window.

session_flatten.cash_close_action: Sample the close for the continuous close-to-close curve; do not liquidate or reset exposure.

early_close_exception.effect: Sample the shortened session's official close without flattening or resetting benchmark exposure.

session_flatten.reason: MNQ_BUY_AND_HOLD is a continuous close-to-close market benchmark independent of Topstep rules.

notes: The continuous-series construction and any back adjustment must remain fixed across all future reports.
The official CME equity-index-futures calendar supplies shortened-session close timestamps; do not infer them from missing bars.
Topstep entry cutoffs and hard-flatten rules never alter this benchmark curve.

structural.name: cash_close
structural.description: Regular-session close used to sample the close-to-close market curve.

structural.name: early_close_calendar
structural.description: On shortened sessions, sample the official CME early close.

structural.name: initial_capital_usd
structural.description: Normalization base for the benchmark equity curve.

execution.name: transaction_costs
execution.description: Benchmark measures market price performance rather than a futures trading implementation.

execution.name: roll_handling
execution.description: No synthetic roll reconstruction is introduced.

execution.name: session_timezone
execution.description: Session closes are identified in New York time.

execution.name: daily_flatten
execution.description: Keep continuous close-to-close exposure; do not flatten each day.

execution.name: topstep_rules_applied
execution.description: The market benchmark is independent of Topstep entry and flatten rules.

lookahead_risks.risk: Selecting the first or last date after inspecting strategy performance changes the benchmark window.
lookahead_risks.control: Use exactly the same predeclared calendar window as the strategy report being compared.

lookahead_risks.risk: A continuous futures series may contain roll adjustment artifacts.
lookahead_risks.control: Use the same frozen continuous MNQ series for every comparison and disclose its roll construction when available.

execution_ambiguities.risk: A normalized continuous-futures price curve is not a directly tradable cash buy-and-hold position.
execution_ambiguities.control: Label it as a market price benchmark and do not apply active-strategy commissions, slippage, or session flattening.

remaining_assumptions.description: The provided continuous MNQ close series is accepted unchanged as the passive market proxy.
The comparison window is fixed before active-strategy metrics are computed.
